_comment: PII linter hook for OpenCode CLI.
Install: `pii-lint install-hooks opencode` merges this into
PostToolUse: after the agent writes/edits a file, scan it. The
env var $OPENCODE_TOOL_FILE_PATH is set by OpenCode
when the hook fires. Exit 2 on HIGH+ so the agent
is forced to redact before continuing.
Stop:        at end-of-turn, scan the staged diff. Exit 2 to
force a cleanup turn before the agent signs off.

hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$OPENCODE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pii-lint scan -- "$f" || exit 2;; esac'
